rounding: Floor fractional final running seconds; retain exact numerator and denominator in audit inputs.
requirements: Exactly four complete consecutive runner-local weeks before the target training week for observed-history calculations
Explicit coverage declarations; absence of records never proves zero or complete coverage
One current training episode with no unresolved interruption
Actual running seconds must be explicitly supported; GPS and guided elapsed time are not running time
No automatic candidate selection, prescription, transformation or publication
limitations: Four weeks and all three formulas are research comparison candidates, not validated safety rules
The lower-reference method is not established as medically safer or superior
Complete outcome reporting does not prove complete activity-history coverage
Repeatable bout and accumulated-session compatibility may require additional evidence and reviewed policy
